about: Regression and coverage tasks for the requirements pipeline (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-24-requirements-evidence-exploration-design.md). Each query runs once per configuration through scripts/evaluate-requirements.ts. Checks describe what a human reviewer should confirm; they are not model judgments.

queries.q: official whatsapp chat ui interface from over past 3 years
queries.tests: Official status and publication dates need evidence; results together should cover each year since 2023-09-24.
reviewer_checks: Result is published by WhatsApp or Meta itself
Publication date is inside the window
Shows or describes the chat interface

queries.tests: Article-only format: videos cannot satisfy it. The misspelling must still reach Roswell material.
reviewer_checks: A real publication rather than fiction

queries.q: robert greene art of seduction pdf
queries.tests: A summary cannot qualify as the full book; legitimate buy, borrow or subscription pages can; unauthorized copies are never served.
reviewer_checks: Gives access to the complete book (not a summary, review or excerpt)
Access is legitimate (store, library, subscription, publisher)

queries.q: timeline of the James Webb Space Telescope deployment with official NASA, ESA and CSA sources
queries.tests: Harder multi-source task: result-set coverage. The results together should include an official source from each of NASA, ESA and CSA about the December 2021 - July 2022 deployment.
reviewer_checks: Published by NASA, ESA or CSA
